title: Completion accepted 0.1
description: Response to POST /v1/case-executions/{case_execution_id}/complete. It confirms the completion was recorded exactly once and reports what Redbeak did next. Replaying the same idempotency key returns this same body rather than queueing a second evaluation, which is what lets a killed runner restart without duplicating evidence.

status.description: `evaluation_queued` follows a `completed` case, which has a judgeable answer. A case that ended `execution_failed` or `canceled` is `recorded`: the state machine makes those terminal rather than routing them to the evaluator, so claiming evaluation was queued for them would be false.
